pkgmetadata.longdescription: bonob implements the Sonos SMAPI (SOAP/WSDL) integration that lets a Sonos speaker fetch and play tracks from a Subsonic-API-compatible music server (Navidrome, Funkwhale, Airsonic, Jellyfin with the Subsonic plugin, etc.). It exposes a Subsonic-compatible library to the Sonos controller and proxies audio through an embedded HTTP server. Built with Node.js and TypeScript; sharp is used for server-side image processing of cover art (requires libvips).
